<?php
class Stop112A extends Exception {}
function stream112A($stop) {
    echo 'INIT|'; $value = yield 3 => 'head'; echo 'VALUE|', $value, '|';
    try { yield 4 => 'tail'; }
    catch (Stop112A $caught) { echo 'CATCH|', $caught === $stop, '|'; yield 'caught'; }
    finally { echo 'FIN|'; }
    return 112;
}
$stop = new Stop112A(); $generator = stream112A($stop); $weak = WeakReference::create($generator);
$current = $generator->current(...); $key = $generator->key(...); $valid = $generator->valid(...);
$rewind = $generator->rewind(...); $send = $generator->send(...); $throw = $generator->throw(...);
$next = $generator->next(...); $getReturn = $generator->getReturn(...); $generator = null;
echo 'CAPTURE|', $current instanceof Closure, '|', $weak->get() instanceof Generator, '|';
try { $throw(exception: 17); }
catch (TypeError $error) {
    $trace = $error->getTrace();
    echo 'TYPE|', $error->getMessage() === 'Generator::throw(): Argument #1 ($exception) must be of type Throwable, int given', '|',
        $trace[0]['class'] === 'Generator', '|', $trace[0]['function'] === 'throw', '|', $trace[0]['args'][0] === 17, '|', !isset($trace[1]), '|';
}
echo 'CURRENT|', $current(), '|', $key(), '|', $valid(), '|'; $rewind();
echo 'SEND|', $send(value: 41), '|'; echo 'THROW|', $throw(exception: $stop), '|';
$next(...[]); echo 'RETURN|', $getReturn(), '|', $valid() === false, '|', $weak->get() instanceof Generator, '|';
unset($current, $key, $valid, $rewind, $send, $throw, $next, $getReturn);
echo 'DROP|', $weak->get() === null, '|';

<?php
function stream112B() {
    try { echo 'INIT|'; $value = yield 'head'; echo 'VALUE|', $value, '|'; yield 'tail'; }
    finally { echo 'FIN|'; }
}
$generator = stream112B(); $weak = WeakReference::create($generator); $array = [$generator, 'SeNd'];
$capture = Closure::fromCallable($array); $array = null; $generator = null;
echo 'CAPTURE|', $capture instanceof Closure, '|', $weak->get() instanceof Generator, '|';
$result = $capture(...['value' => 41]); echo 'RETURN|', $result === 'tail', '|', $weak->get() instanceof Generator, '|';
$capture = null; echo 'DROP|', $weak->get() === null, '|';

purpose: A supplied cache-destructor exception observes capture already dead and Generator storage live, keeps caller trace/original exception identity, and finishes both weak retirements before catch.
source:
<?php
class Stop112T extends Exception {}
class Token112T {
    function __construct() { global $weakToken; $weakToken = WeakReference::create($this); }
    function __destruct() {
        global $weakGenerator, $weakCapture, $stop;
        $trace = (new Exception('probe'))->getTrace();
        echo 'DTOR|', $weakGenerator->get() instanceof Generator, '|', $weakCapture->get() === null, '|';
        echo 'TRACE|', $trace[0]['function'] === '__destruct', '|', $trace[0]['class'] === 'Token112T', '|', $trace[1]['function'] === 'run112T', '|', !isset($trace[2]), '|';
        throw $stop;
    }
}
function stream112T() { try { echo 'INIT|'; yield new Token112T(); } finally { echo 'FIN|'; } }
function drop112T() { global $capture; $capture = null; return []; }
function run112T() { global $capture; echo 'CALL|'; $capture(...drop112T()); echo 'BAD-RETURN|'; }
$stop = new Stop112T('given'); $generator = stream112T(); $weakGenerator = WeakReference::create($generator);
$capture = $generator->current(...); $weakCapture = WeakReference::create($capture); $generator = null;
try { run112T(); }
catch (Stop112T $caught) {
    echo 'CATCH|', $caught === $stop, '|', $stop->getTrace() === [], '|', $stop->getPrevious() === null, '|', $weakGenerator->get() === null, '|', $weakCapture->get() === null, '|', $weakToken->get() === null, '|';
}
echo 'DONE|';
